metadata.description: Security evaluations for AI models, agents, applications and the defences around them.

plugins.name: ai-review
plugins.description: Guided security review of an AI capability: scope it, gather vendor evidence, model the threats, set your own acceptance criteria, and compile the report. Measures and records; never decides.

plugins.name: model-evals
plugins.description: Evaluate a model release, open-weights or frontier: a fixed suite of security benchmarks run on the same samples for every model.

plugins.name: agent-evals
plugins.description: Evaluate an AI agent in the harness it runs in: whether it carries out offensive work when asked, and guided reviews of agent features such as computer use, memory and connectors.

plugins.name: app-evals
plugins.description: Evaluate an LLM application's endpoint: a fixed adversarial benchmark and adaptive multi-turn red teaming.

plugins.name: defense-evals
plugins.description: Evaluate how well a defence works: guardrails, guidance placed in front of a coding agent, and security tools, each measured against a baseline or known answers.
